title.zh: 當專案進度嚴重落後，你如何向相關利益者（Stakeholders）說明並解決？
title.en: When a project is severely delayed, how do you communicate with stakeholders and resolve it?

intent.zh: 考驗危機處理、誠實度以及是否具備主動溝通的擔當。
intent.en: Tests crisis management, honesty, and proactive communication.

safe_landing_script.zh: 呢個問題好有挑戰性。請畀我 10 秒鐘整理思維，我想從『損害控管』同『替代方案』兩個方向去回應...
safe_landing_script.en: That is a great question. Please give me 10 seconds to organize my thoughts on damage control and contingency plans...

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我預咗你會遇到困難，但我最怕你隱瞞不報，爆鍋先講。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "I expect you to face challenges, but I fear you hiding them until it's too late."

script.zh: 我會先盤點手上受影響的工作，整理成簡短清單，第一時間向主管匯報，並提出我可以加班或調整優先順序的兩個選項供主管決策。
script.en: I will audit my affected tasks, prepare a concise summary, report to my manager immediately, and offer options such as prioritizing tasks or working overtime.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「我唔想聽你報告壞消息，我要聽你的補救方案跟所需的資源。」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Don't just bring me bad news; bring me mitigation plans and resource requirements."

script.zh: 我會評估延誤的瓶頸，向 Stakeholder 提出兩個方案：一是削減 20% 非核心功能以按時交付；二是增加資源延後一週，並分析利弊。
script.en: I will evaluate the bottlenecks and offer stakeholders two options: reduce 20% non-core scope for on-time delivery, or add resources to defer by a week.

hiring_manager_os.zh: 「你能不能站在公司商業利益的角度止血？事後如何建立體制防止再發生？」
hiring_manager_os.en: "Can you mitigate risks from a business ROI perspective and establish systems to prevent recurrence?"

focus.zh: 商業風險控管與制度復盤 (Post-mortem)

script.zh: 我會親自與高層 Stakeholder 對齊商業影響，重新排定優先順序以保住核心商業價值；同時啟動備用資源止血，並在事後進行團隊復盤，更新 SOP。
script.en: I will align with senior stakeholders to protect core business value, deploy contingency resources, and conduct a post-mortem to update our SOPs.
